text:
Maya: Quick sync idea — run a compact PLG experiment: "micro-lab" webinar (20m) + 30 starter credits + 3 plug-and-play prompt templates. Hypothesis: bundled onramp reduces TTFS and lifts week-1 active by ~20%.
Owen: Sounds good. Primary metric? Recommend: % new signups with >=1 successful gen within 24h AND ttfs <= 10m.
Rhea: Cohorts: control | credits_only | webinar_only | bundle. Need control.
Carl: Traffic plan: product banner, blog, Discord, small paid push to devs. Use utm params like ?utm_source=banner&utm_campaign=micro_lab_v1&arm=bundle.
PromoBot: Promo pool created: micro_lab_pool (2000 codes). Endpoint: POST /promo/assign {user_id,pool} -> {code,expires_at}. Single-use, 14d expiry.
Maya: Make sure codes attach to user metadata promo_origin=micro_lab and are idempotent on first login.
Rhea: Prompt templates: "Short cold outreach", "Feature brainstorming (3 bullets)", "Data->insights (1-paragraph)". Keep under 60 tokens.
Owen: Include an inline runnable snippet on landing (curl + sample). 1-click run if logged in reduces friction.
Carl: Landing copy A/B: H1A "Micro-lab: Try starter prompts + credits" vs H1B "Reserve 20-min lab + claim credits". CTA test as well.
Rhea: Measurement: capture signup_source, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_gen_ts, gen_count_24h, ttfs, retention_d7. QA with 2 test accounts.
Maya: Owners: Carl - landing & social narrative; Rhea - templates & webinar script; Owen - metric spec + analysis plan; PromoBot - promo integration.
Owen: Analysis labels: arm_control | arm_credits | arm_webinar | arm_bundle. Power note: baseline ~11% -> need ~1.6k/arm for 80% power. If short, stretch to 4 weeks.
Carl: I'll draft two social narratives: technical and PM-focused, keep factual (benchmarks + time-to-first-prompt).
PromoBot: Reminder: assign endpoint requires service token from /secrets; rotateable. Maintenance window 1860015000-1860018600 UTC.
Maya: Solid. Draft experiment brief and share link here by Thu noon. Weekly check Fri 9am PT. :rocket:
